label: Fugue in C minor, BWV 549
caution: Read from Tobi's MusicXML file (Tobis Notenarchiv), notes, ties and names as they stand there; the voices were sorted by this program from the file's staves, stems and beams, and have not been proofread note by note. The bass is in the left hand until the pedal takes it over. The pedal comes in only at bar 40, and the last bars are a free close in chords and runs.
title: Prelude and Fugue in C minor, BWV 549: Fugue

sections.label: Link
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes. Returns in Episode 1 (bars 20–24).
sections.leads: From G minor to C minor

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Reworks Link (bar 16) in part, with soprano and tenor exchanged, transposed. Soprano: a figure from the subject (4 times) and the opening of the subject (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: the opening of the subject (2 times) and a figure from the subject and a figure from the subject, inverted. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: Between two statements in C minor

sections.label: Link
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject. Tenor: a figure from the subject.
sections.leads: From C minor to G minor

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted and a figure from the subject. Tenor: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From G minor to C minor; perfect cadence in C minor at bar 32

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted and the opening of the subject. Alto: a figure from the subject. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject and the opening of the subject.
sections.leads: Between two statements in C minor; perfect cadence in C minor at bar 39

sections.label: Coda
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in C minor at bar 46
